mapper.sql: SELECT gt.subject_id AS user_id FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' UNION SELECT ud.user_id FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN user_dept ud ON gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id AND dc.ancestor_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} UNION SELECT up.user_id FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN user_post up ON gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND up.post_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId}
